events.desc: The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Why, what a MAGNIFICENT manor! Simply splendid! I do hope everyone is comfortable. My, my — Penelope dear, how wonderful to see you safe and sound! Now then, let me just have a look around this charming foyer...

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! That chandelier is hanging by a THREAD! How perfectly convenient. If I can lure dear Penelope beneath it at just the right moment... but patience, Sneekly, PATIENCE. First I must scout this dreary old manor for the most DIABOLICALLY elaborate trap opportunities. The treasure hunt is merely my cover — Penelope's DOOM is the real prize!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) examined the null.

Penelope Pitstop: Why, HELLOOO everybody! Isn't this just the most DARLIN' little manor house y'all ever did see? Oh my stars, a guest book! A lady ALWAYS signs the guest book — and who knows what little secrets previous visitors might have left behind! Let me just take a teensy peek!

Now then, Penelope, you simply MUST find that Doily Diamond. A guest book in a mystery mansion is practically BEGGIN' to be read — there could be clues from previous visitors about where that diamond is hidden!
Penelope Pitstop examined the guest-book.

The Ant Hill Mob: Alright boys, we made it! Doily Manor — what a joint! Now listen up, Dum-Dum, Zippy, all of youse — Miss Pitstop is right here and so are a buncha suspicious characters. That Sneekly fella gives me the CREEPS, and I don't trust that Dastardly neither. We gotta keep our peepers peeled! Now let's have a look around this dump before somethin' terrible happens to our dear Miss Pitstop!

Something about that Sneekly character don't sit right with me and the boys. He's got that look — you know the look — like a guy who's up to NO GOOD. And that chandelier up there... it's hangin' by a thread! This whole place is givin' me the heebie-jeebies!
The Ant Hill Mob examined the null.

Peter Perfect: Why, Penelope! What a SPLENDID surprise to find you here at Doily Manor! You look positively RADIANT, even amidst all this dust and gloom. Now don't you worry one little bit — Peter Perfect is HERE, and I shall ensure your safety through whatever perils this old manor may hold! But first, as any proper gentleman would do upon entering a fine estate, allow me to inspect this guest book. One never knows what VITAL clues previous visitors may have left behind!

Oh boy oh boy — Penelope AND a mysterious manor AND a treasure to find? This is my chance to show her what a TRUE hero looks like! Now if I can just keep from tripping over that wobbly coat rack on my way to the guest book, everything will be PERFECT... just like me!
Peter Perfect examined the guest-book.

Dick Dastardly: Well, well, WELL! What a MAGNIFICENT gathering of... lesser competitors! I, Dick Dastardly, have arrived — and I bring URGENT news! I happen to know from a VERY reliable source that the treasure of Doily Manor is hidden beneath the kitchen floor! Yes, yes — under the old wood-burning stove! You'd all better rush there IMMEDIATELY before someone else finds it! Heh heh heh!

Of COURSE the treasure isn't in the kitchen — I just made that up! While these gullible fools go rummaging through pots and pans, I shall sneak into the library and examine that inscription on the mantelpiece. Dick Dastardly strikes AGAIN! Heh heh heh heh!
Dick Dastardly walked into the library.

Penelope Pitstop: Well now, that guest book was just LOVELY but it didn't have any clues about the Doily Diamond, I'm afraid! Oh, but did y'all hear that? A carved stone mantelpiece with an INSCRIPTION in the Library! Why, that sounds like it could be a CLUE! A lady with a mystery to solve simply CANNOT ignore an inscription, now can she? I do declare, I'm headin' straight for that Library! Y'all are welcome to join me — the more the merrier, as Mama Pitstop always said!

Oh my stars, this is SO excitin'! An inscription on a mantelpiece in a dusty old manor — that's practically SCREAMIN' 'secret clue!' Why, I just KNOW the Doily Diamond is waitin' for little ol' me to find it!
Penelope Pitstop walked into the library.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Well now, what a DELIGHTFUL gathering we have here! But my goodness, we mustn't all dawdle about in the foyer like lost little ducklings, hmm? As Penelope's humble guardian, I feel it is my DUTY to scout ahead and ensure this old manor is perfectly safe. I noticed a LIBRARY just through there — I shall go and inspect it for any... hazards. Safety first, after all! Do carry on, everyone!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! Safety first indeed — safety for EVERYONE except dear sweet Penelope! That library holds SECRETS, I can feel it in my villainous bones. A carved inscription on the mantelpiece? Why, that practically SCREAMS hidden mechanism! Once I discover the manor's secrets, I shall devise such an ELABORATE and THEATRICAL demise for Penelope that even the most discerning villain would weep with admiration! Off to the Library, Sneekly — your GREATEST scheme awaits!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) walked into the library.

Peter Perfect: Well now, that guest book was MOST illuminating! But I do believe the REAL secrets of this manor lie deeper within. Penelope, my dear, I noticed there is a Library just through there with what appears to be an inscription on the mantelpiece — and as any gallant gentleman knows, one must ALWAYS investigate mysterious inscriptions! I shall venture forth and ensure it is perfectly safe before you set one dainty foot in that direction. Peter Perfect leaves NOTHING to chance!

If I can decipher that inscription before anyone else — especially that scoundrel Dastardly — Penelope will see that I'm not just dashingly handsome, but CLEVER too! Though I do hope the Library floor is sturdier than this foyer... that chandelier looks like it could come down at any moment. Stay focused, Peter — heroism AWAITS!
Peter Perfect walked into the library.

The Ant Hill Mob: Hey, hey, HEY! Would ya look at this coat rack, boys? It's wobblier than Dum-Dum's knees after a car chase! Somebody could get HURT with this thing just standin' here all rickety-like! Zippy, Pockets — stay close to Miss Pitstop while I check this out. And YOU, Sneekly — yeah, YOU with the creepy smile — don't go wanderin' off nowhere suspicious, capisce?

I don't know WHAT it is about that Sneekly fella, but every time he looks at Miss Pitstop, I get this terrible feelin' in my gut — like the time we tried to rob that bank and the vault door was already open. Somethin' ain't right, boys. Somethin' ain't right at ALL.
The Ant Hill Mob examined the coat-rack.

Dick Dastardly: Ah HA! The library — all MINE! Well, well, what have we here? A charming little inscription! Let old Dick Dastardly put his BRILLIANT mind to work! Oh — Rock, Gravel, how DELIGHTFUL to see you boys. Don't mind me, I'm just... admiring the stonework. Nothing to see here, nothing at ALL!

Heh heh heh! While those fools are elbow-deep in kitchen grease, I, the MAGNIFICENT Dick Dastardly, shall crack this riddle wide open! The answer is obviously a MAP — and where there's a map in a manor, there's TREASURE! Oh, I can practically TASTE the glory!
Dick Dastardly interacted with the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: Why, Penelope, my dear, you were ABSOLUTELY right to come to the Library! And would you look at THAT — a riddle inscribed upon the mantelpiece! Now, as a gentleman of considerable intellect AND dashing good looks, allow ME to solve this little puzzle for you! 'Cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish' — why, that's a MAP, of course! A MAP! Stand back, everyone — Peter Perfect is about to crack this case WIDE open!

Oh, this is PERFECT! A riddle that I actually KNOW the answer to! If I solve this before Dastardly or that peculiar Sneekly fellow, Penelope will be SO impressed! She'll see that I'm not just a pretty face behind the wheel of the Turbo Terrific — I'm a man of LETTERS too! Though I do hope interacting with this mantelpiece doesn't trigger some sort of booby trap... but a true hero doesn't hesitate!
Peter Perfect interacted with the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Why, HELLO there, everyone! Isn't this library just DIVINE? All these dusty old books and — oh my STARS, would you look at that inscription on the mantelpiece! 'I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish.' Well now, let me think... cities but no HOUSES... forests but no TREES... Why, that's a MAP, of course! Every proper Southern lady learns her riddles right alongside her table manners! Let me just see what happens when I give this ol' mantelpiece the answer!

Why, I do hope this riddle leads to a secret compartment or a treasure map! Wouldn't THAT just be the cat's pajamas! And how NICE of all these gentlemen to keep me company — though I must say, Mr. Sneekly does look a teensy bit familiar under that hood...
Penelope Pitstop interacted with the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: BOYS! What are we DOIN' standin' around here like a buncha tourists?! Miss Pitstop just walked into that library with Dastardly AND that Sneekly character — the one that gives me the WILLIES! We gotta get in there and make sure she's okay! Come on, come on, COME ON! Move it, move it! Dum-Dum, grab my hat — Zippy, you take point — everybody SCRAMBLE!

I got a BAD feelin' about this, folks. Two shifty characters followin' Miss Pitstop into a room full of books? That's like two foxes followin' a hen into a henhouse — except the hen is a BEAUTIFUL LADY and the henhouse has got an inscription that could be a CLUE to the treasure! If anything happens to her in there, I'll never forgive myself! The Ant Hill Mob don't let NOBODY mess with Miss Pitstop — even if we gotta trip over every piece of furniture in the joint to stop 'em!
The Ant Hill Mob walked into the library.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Oh my, my, MY! What a FASCINATING inscription we have here! As a man of letters — and Penelope's ever-vigilant guardian — allow ME to examine this little puzzle! 'Cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish...' Why, that's elementary, my dear friends! The answer is... a MAP!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! A MAP! Oh, this is simply DELICIOUS! If this mantelpiece conceals a map to the Doily Diamond, I shall be the FIRST to lay my scheming hands upon it! And once I know where the treasure lies, I can lure sweet, unsuspecting Penelope into the most MAGNIFICENTLY elaborate trap this manor has ever seen! Perhaps a pit beneath the floorboards... or a cage disguised as a treasure chest... oh, the POSSIBILITIES are making my villainous heart SING!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) interacted with the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Oh, what a DREADFULLY difficult riddle! I, Dick Dastardly — genius extraordinaire — have been studying it most carefully, and I can tell you all with ABSOLUTE certainty that the answer is... a BATHTUB! Yes, yes — cities, forests, water — it's OBVIOUSLY a bathtub! Nothing more to see here, I assure you! Why don't you all run along to the kitchen? I hear there's a MARVELOUS collection of antique silverware down there!

Heh heh heh! A BATHTUB! As if! The answer is a MAP, you fools! But while these simpletons puzzle over my deliberate misdirection, I need to examine this mantelpiece more closely. Something MUST have happened when I interacted with it — a secret compartment, a hidden lever, SOMETHING! The treasure of Doily Manor will be MINE! ALL MINE!
Dick Dastardly examined the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: Why, would you LOOK at that! The answer, my dear Penelope, is a MAP! Cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish — it can ONLY be a map! Now let me just examine this mantelpiece more closely to see what my brilliant deduction has revealed... Peter Perfect solves riddles AND looks magnificent doing it!

Oh, I DO hope something actually happened when I interacted with it. It would be TERRIBLY embarrassing to announce my triumph and then have nothing to show for it. But fortune favors the bold — and the well-groomed!
Peter Perfect examined the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Oh my STARS, did y'all see that? I gave that mantelpiece the answer — a MAP! Because cities without houses, forests without trees, and water without fish — why, that's a map if ever there WAS one! Now let me take a CLOSER look and see if somethin' opened up! A proper lady always inspects the results of her riddle-solvin'!

Why, I do hope something WONDERFUL happened when I answered that riddle! A secret drawer, a hidden map, a clue to the Doily Diamond — anything at ALL! And isn't it just PRECIOUS how everyone rushed to the library to help little ol' me? Even that Mr. Sneekly with his hood — such a mysterious but I'm SURE perfectly trustworthy gentleman!
Penelope Pitstop examined the mantelpiece.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Oh my, oh my! Let me just take a CLOSER look at this mantelpiece, shall I? As Penelope's guardian, I simply MUST ensure there are no dangerous mechanisms or — or SHARP edges! One can never be too careful in these old manors, you know!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! The fools all shouted the answer at once, but I was the one who TOUCHED it first! Now let me see what secrets this mantelpiece has surrendered — if there's a map hidden within, it shall be MINE! And once I know where the treasure lies, I'll arrange such a FIENDISHLY clever trap for dear Penelope that she'll never see it coming! Perhaps the map leads somewhere with... NATURAL HAZARDS I can enhance! Oh, the villainy of it all makes me TINGLE with delight!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) examined the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Out of my WAY, you bumbling buffoons! I, Dick Dastardly, have FINALLY deduced the TRUE answer to this riddle — and it is NOT a map, as you simpletons believe! The answer is clearly... well, never mind WHAT it is! Stand ASIDE while I demonstrate my superior intellect!

Of COURSE the answer is a map — I'm not a complete imbecile! But I can't let these fools know I agree with them. Now let me interact with this mantelpiece properly — examining it got me nowhere! There MUST be a hidden mechanism, a secret compartment, SOMETHING that leads to the treasure! And with all these distractions around me, I need to act FAST before that dreadful Hooded Claw or that insufferable Peter Perfect stumble onto something valuable!
Dick Dastardly interacted with the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: HEY HEY HEY! Hold on just a MINUTE there, Sneekly! You can't just go pushin' and proddin' at mysterious inscriptions without consultin' the REST of us! What if that thing was BOOBY-TRAPPED, huh?! You coulda brought the whole ceiling down on Miss Pitstop's beautiful head! Dum-Dum, Zippy — get over here and help me check this thing out! Pockets, you stand next to Miss Pitstop! Nobody gets near her without goin' through the Ant Hill Mob FIRST! Now lemme get a look at what this wise guy just — OOF! — who put that CHAIR there?!

I don't trust that Sneekly character as far as Dum-Dum could throw him — which, come to think of it, is actually pretty far. But there's somethin' about the way he's always RIGHT THERE whenever Miss Pitstop is around... always got the answers... always bein' so HELPFUL. In my line of work, when somebody's THAT helpful, they're usually helpin' themselves. I just wish I could figure out what his angle is!
The Ant Hill Mob examined the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: Why, Penelope, you solved that riddle before ANY of us could even read the full inscription! A MAP — of COURSE! Cities, forests, water — all things found on a map but never the REAL thing! Your brilliance is matched ONLY by your beauty, my dear! Now, allow ME to do the heavy lifting — if there's a secret mechanism in this mantelpiece, Peter Perfect shall find it! Stand back, everyone — especially YOU, Dastardly, with your ridiculous bathtub nonsense!

Sneekly got to the mantelpiece first — confound it! But perhaps there's MORE to discover. A thorough gentleman examines EVERY stone, EVERY groove. If there's a hidden compartment, Peter Perfect's meticulous nature shall uncover it! And Penelope will see that while ANYONE can shout the answer, only a TRUE hero follows through!
Peter Perfect interacted with the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Now hold on just a MOMENT, y'all! I do believe I only LOOKED at that mantelpiece — I didn't actually SOLVE the riddle proper-like! The answer is a MAP, clear as a Georgia sunrise! Cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish — why, that describes a map PERFECTLY! Let me just give this inscription a proper lady's touch and see what happens!
Oh, I do hope this works! A secret compartment, a hidden passage — anything that leads to the Doily Diamond! And how SWEET of all these gentlemen to let little ol' me have another try!
Penelope Pitstop interacted with the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: BAH! This mantelpiece is WORTHLESS — a mere decorative trinket! The REAL treasure, I happen to know, is in the Laboratory! Yes, yes — hidden inside that large machine with all the levers and dials! You should ALL rush there at ONCE! Go on, shoo! Every last one of you!

Heh heh heh! As IF I'd tell them about those upside-down books! While these credulous chumps stampede toward the Laboratory to fiddle with some ridiculous machine, I, the GREAT Dick Dastardly, shall discover the REAL secret hidden in these bookshelves! Those inverted volumes are clearly a mechanism — pull the right one and a secret passage opens! It's SO obvious that only a genius of MY caliber could spot it!
Dick Dastardly examined the bookshelves.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Oh GOODNESS me, how thrilling! A map — yes, yes, of COURSE it's a map! Now, as Penelope's guardian, I really MUST insist on being the one to — to check this mechanism, you understand! These old manor contraptions can be TERRIBLY dangerous — spring-loaded panels, hidden spikes, all sorts of dreadful hazards! Please, everyone, stand BACK while old Sneekly ensures it's perfectly safe!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! That bumbling Dastardly got his grubby fingers on it first, but I — the HOODED CLAW — shall not be outdone! If this mantelpiece conceals a map to the Doily Diamond, then I must be the one to POSSESS it! And once I have the map... oh, the POSSIBILITIES for arranging dear Penelope's demise along the route to the treasure! Perhaps a conveniently placed trapdoor, or a chandelier rigged to fall at PRECISELY the right moment! The anticipation is simply DELICIOUS!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) interacted with the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: Well now, everyone seems to have had a go at this magnificent mantelpiece, but Peter Perfect knows that the DEVIL is in the DETAILS! Penelope, my dear, you brilliantly deduced that the answer is a MAP — and I do believe your interaction may have triggered something! Allow me to conduct a THOROUGH inspection of every nook and cranny. A gentleman of my caliber leaves NO stone unturned — quite LITERALLY in this case! If there's a hidden compartment or secret passage, my keen eye shall find it!

Everyone's been poking at this mantelpiece like it's a piñata at a birthday party, but NONE of them have the patience for a proper examination. Peter Perfect's thoroughness is about to pay dividends! If I can discover what the riddle actually REVEALED — a map, a hidden chamber, a secret drawer — Penelope will see that I'm the ONLY one here who follows through properly. Dastardly's too busy being ridiculous, Sneekly's oddly eager to get his hands on things, and the Mob are tripping over furniture. This is MY moment!
Peter Perfect examined the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: Alright, alright, EVERYBODY just SIMMER DOWN! The Ant Hill Mob is takin' CHARGE of this situation! Dum-Dum, you keep your eyes on Sneekly over there — and Zippy, you stay close to Miss Pitstop! Now lemme get a look at this mantelpiece — a MAP, right? Cities, no houses, forests, no trees — even POCKETS coulda figured that one out! Now let's see what happens when a PROFESSIONAL handles this thing — OOPS! — sorry there, Sneekly, didn't see ya standin' so close! Maybe you oughta take a FEW STEPS BACK from Miss Pitstop while you're at it! Comin' through, comin' through!

That was NO accident, me bumpin' into Sneekly like that. Well — okay, it WAS an accident, I tripped on one of them dusty books on the floor — but the RESULT was intentional! Every time I knock that guy away from Miss Pitstop, even by fallin' on my face, that's a WIN in my book. There's somethin' rotten in the state of Denmark — or whatever state this creepy manor is in — and it's wearin' a bow tie and callin' itself a guardian!
The Ant Hill Mob interacted with the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Well now, I DO believe somethin' might have happened when I touched that inscription! Did y'all hear a little CLICK? Or was that just my imagination runnin' wild like a Georgia peach rollin' downhill? Let me take a CLOSER look at this mantelpiece — a proper lady always inspects her handiwork, after all!

Oh, I just KNOW that riddle answer was right — a MAP! Cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish! Now if only this old mantelpiece would cooperate and show me what it's hidin'! The Doily Diamond could be just one secret compartment away!
Penelope Pitstop examined the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Yes, yes, everyone gather round the mantelpiece! Watch Sneekly VERY carefully — I'm SURE something WONDERFUL is about to happen! Pay NO attention to me over here, I'm merely... dusting the shelves! Heh heh!

Heh heh heh! The FOOLS are all mesmerized by that ridiculous riddle contraption while I, the BRILLIANT Dick Dastardly, work the REAL puzzle! Those upside-down books are OBVIOUSLY a combination lock — turn them right-side up in the correct order and a secret passage opens! It's elementary, really — for a GENIUS like me!

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Oh my, oh my! Did everyone see that? I believe the mechanism has RESPONDED to my touch! Let old Sneekly just take a CLOSER look here — purely for safety purposes, you understand! These Victorian contraptions can be MOST unpredictable, and as Penelope's guardian I simply CANNOT allow anyone to be harmed by a — a spring-loaded whatchamacallit or a poisoned needle trap! Everyone please remain where you are!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! The mechanism has been ACTIVATED! Now I must see what treasure it has revealed before that meddlesome Ant Hill Mob or that preening Peter Perfect gets their grubby little hands on it! If there is a MAP hidden within this mantelpiece, then I — the HOODED CLAW — shall be the one to claim it! And with the map in MY possession, I can set the MOST magnificent trap along the route to the treasure! Oh, the DIABOLICAL possibilities are making me positively GIDDY!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) examined the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Oh, HUSH now, everyone — let a lady CONCENTRATE! Now, this inscription says 'I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish.' Why, the answer is as clear as sweet tea on a summer day — it's a MAP, sugar! A MAP has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish! Now let's see what happens when I give this ol' mantelpiece the RIGHT answer!

Oh, I do SO love a good riddle! And with all these wonderful friends gathered 'round to help, why, solvin' the mystery of the Doily Diamond is practically a PARTY! I wonder what secret this mantelpiece is hidin' — a hidden compartment, perhaps? Or maybe even a SECRET PASSAGE! How simply THRILLING!
Penelope Pitstop interacted with the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: Why, Miss Pitstop, your BRILLIANT deduction that the answer is a MAP was simply INSPIRED! Now, if you'll permit me — the Ant Hill Mob have given it a good rattling, but what this mechanism REALLY needs is the PRECISE touch of a gentleman! You see, these old manor riddle-locks require one to speak the answer while engaging the mechanism — it's all about FINESSE, not force! Stand back, everyone — Peter Perfect shall demonstrate the PROPER technique! The answer, dear mantelpiece, is a MAP!

If I can be the one to actually OPEN whatever this mantelpiece is hiding, Penelope will see that Peter Perfect combines brains AND bravery! Though I do wish Sneekly would stop hovering quite so close — there's something about that fellow that makes my mustache twitch. But no — mustn't be uncharitable. Focus, Peter! GLORY awaits!
Peter Perfect interacted with the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: Hey hey HEY! Did everybody hear that?! A CLICK! That mantelpiece just went CLICK when Miss Pitstop touched it, and then I gave it a good shove — accidentally, on account of my MOMENTUM from bumpin' into Sneekly there — and I think somethin' MOVED! Lemme get a closer look at this thing! Boys, form a PERIMETER around Miss Pitstop! Dum-Dum, you stand on her left! Zippy, you stand on her right! And Sneekly — with ALL due respect to your so-called guardianship — you can stand over THERE by the bookshelf where it's SAFE! Yeah, real safe! For EVERYBODY!

I ain't no detective, but I know when somethin' smells fishier than Coney Island on a hot day. Sneekly wants to be the one checkin' the mechanism? Over my DEAD body — which, knowin' my luck, might happen if I trip over one more book. But even flat on my face, I'm between him and Miss Pitstop, and THAT'S what counts!
The Ant Hill Mob examined the mantelpiece.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Now, now, everyone — as Penelope's guardian, I really MUST insist on being the one to test this mechanism! These old manor contraptions can be terribly dangerous — why, I once knew a fellow who triggered a mantelpiece just like this one and was showered in BATS! Simply dreadful! The answer to this little riddle is quite obviously 'a MAP,' and I shall demonstrate the PROPER way to respond to such an inscription. Stand back, everyone — especially you, my dear Penelope! Guardian's orders!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! Once I speak the answer and trigger this mechanism, whatever map or clue emerges shall be MINE! And with it, I shall lay such a DEVIOUSLY elaborate trap for dear sweet Penelope that even she won't be able to stumble her way out of it! The Ant Hill Mob thinks they can watch me? They can watch me TRIUMPH!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) interacted with the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Out of my WAY, you bumbling amateurs! I, Dick Dastardly, am a WORLD-RENOWNED archaeologist and puzzle solver! That riddle is CHILD'S PLAY — the answer is clearly... well, I shan't spoil it for you simpletons! But THIS mechanism requires a DELICATE touch — a MASTERFUL hand — and since none of YOU qualify, allow ME to demonstrate how a TRUE genius operates! Stand BACK!

Heh heh heh! While they were all bumbling about and examining, I noticed the mantelpiece says INTERACT — meaning there's a MECHANISM to trigger! A map — cities, forests, water — it's a MAP! And if this contraption opens a secret compartment or reveals a hidden passage, Dick Dastardly will be FIRST through the door! The treasure is practically MINE!
Dick Dastardly interacted with the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Why, THANK you, Peter, for bein' such a gentleman! But I do believe little ol' ME said the answer first — a MAP! Now let me just take a teensy-weensy closer look at this mantelpiece, because I have a feelin' somethin' WONDERFUL just happened! Oh, I can practically FEEL the Doily Diamond callin' out to me! 'Penelope! Penelope!' it says! And isn't it just DARLIN' how Sneekly is always lookin' out for my safety? Why, a girl couldn't ask for a more devoted guardian!

Why, I'm simply TINGLY with excitement! That riddle was easier than Mama Pitstop's pecan pie recipe! I just KNOW that mantelpiece is hidin' somethin' spectacular — maybe even the Doily Diamond itself! And with all these helpful friends around, this adventure is turnin' out to be just DELIGHTFUL!
Penelope Pitstop examined the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: AH-HA! Did you HEAR that, Miss Pitstop? I do believe the mechanism has ENGAGED! Years of experience with finely-tuned machinery — my Turbo Terrific has SEVENTEEN precision gearboxes, you know — have given me an INSTINCT for these things! Now, let Peter Perfect take a THOROUGH look at what we've uncovered here. A gentleman ALWAYS inspects the results of his work before declaring victory — that's the Peter Perfect guarantee!

Oh, I DO hope something actually happened when I touched it... it would be TERRIBLY embarrassing to have made that grand speech about finesse only for the mantelpiece to have done absolutely nothing. But even if it didn't budge, a TRUE gentleman never shows doubt! Chin up, Peter!
Peter Perfect examined the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: AH HA! Did you SEE that?! The mechanism responded to MY masterful touch! I, Dick Dastardly, have UNLOCKED the secret of the mantelpiece! Now stand ASIDE, all of you — particularly YOU, Pitstop, and your meddlesome little mob! This is a job for a GENIUS, not a gaggle of do-gooders! Let me just inspect my MAGNIFICENT handiwork here...

Drat! Everyone saw the mechanism activate — now they're ALL crowding around MY discovery! I need to examine this mantelpiece CLOSELY before any of these meddling fools figure out what it revealed. If there's a secret passage or hidden compartment, Dick Dastardly must be the FIRST one through!
Dick Dastardly examined the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: Wait a MINUTE here! Wait just a cotton-pickin' MINUTE! Dastardly says 'pay no attention to me' — well where I come from, that's practically a CONFESSION!
